=== names by case
extraDropFee Money FSC DIESEL_BASE Class77_5 ft3x A
---
name "extraDropFee"
type "Money"
code "FSC"
code "DIESEL_BASE"
type "Class77_5"
name "ft3x"
type "A"

=== keywords and contextual words
let var const if else match for in where and or not true false none as cents to up down half even
---
keyword "let"
keyword "var"
keyword "const"
keyword "if"
keyword "else"
keyword "match"
keyword "for"
keyword "in"
keyword "where"
keyword "and"
keyword "or"
keyword "not"
keyword "true"
keyword "false"
keyword "none"
name "as"
name "cents"
name "to"
name "up"
name "down"
name "half"
name "even"

=== numbers with separators and fractions
1200 1_200 2.35 0.5 1..3 2.x
---
number "1200"
number "1_200"
number "2.35"
number "0.5"
number "1"
punct ".."
number "3"
number "2"
punct "."
name "x"

=== units directly after numbers
500 lb 2.5 mi 4 h 30 min 48 ft 3 pallet 1 stop 12 m3
---
number "500"
unit "lb"
number "2.5"
unit "mi"
number "4"
unit "h"
number "30"
unit "min"
number "48"
unit "ft"
number "3"
unit "pallet"
number "1"
unit "stop"
number "12"
unit "m3"

=== unit words that are not after a number are names
lb + mi
---
name "lb"
punct "+"
name "mi"

=== density units after a number
30 lb/ft3 + 8 mi/gal
---
number "30"
unit "lb"
punct "/"
unit "ft3"
punct "+"
number "8"
unit "mi"
punct "/"
unit "gal"

=== temperatures
-5 °C 40 °F x.in(°C)
---
punct "-"
number "5"
unit "°C"
number "40"
unit "°F"
name "x"
punct "."
keyword "in"
punct "("
unit "°C"
punct ")"

=== a degree sign alone
5 °X
---
number "5"
error "°"
type "X"
! syntax 2..4 Write a temperature unit as `°F` or `°C`

=== money and rates
$450 $2.35/mi $18.50/cwt $1_000.00 $0.05/gal
---
money "$450"
money "$2.35"
punct "/"
unit "mi"
money "$18.50"
punct "/"
unit "cwt"
money "$1_000.00"
money "$0.05"
punct "/"
unit "gal"

=== money divided by a name is division
$10 / mi $10/rate
---
money "$10"
punct "/"
name "mi"
money "$10"
punct "/"
name "rate"

=== dollar without an amount
$ 5
---
error "$"
number "5"
! syntax 0..1 Write money as `$` followed by the amount, like `$450`

=== percents and remainder
18% 0.5% x % 3
---
percent "18%"
percent "0.5%"
name "x"
punct "%"
number "3"

=== dates and date-times
@2026-10-22 @2026-10-22T08:00-05:00 @2026-10-22T08:00:30Z @2024-02-29
---
date "@2026-10-22"
date "@2026-10-22T08:00-05:00"
date "@2026-10-22T08:00:30Z"
date "@2024-02-29"

=== invalid calendar dates
@2026-02-29 @2026-13-01 @2026-10-22T24:00Z @2026-10-22T08:00+18:30
---
error "@2026-02-29"
error "@2026-13-01"
error "@2026-10-22T24:00Z"
error "@2026-10-22T08:00+18:30"
! syntax 0..11 @2026-02-29 is not a real date and time
! syntax 12..23 @2026-13-01 is not a real date and time
! syntax 24..42 @2026-10-22T24:00Z is not a real date and time
! syntax 43..66 @2026-10-22T08:00+18:30 is not a real date and time

=== a malformed date
@2026-1-1
---
error "@2026-1-1"
! syntax 0..9 Write a date as `@2026-10-22`, or a date and time as `@2026-10-22T08:00-05:00`

=== in after a number before a value is the keyword
5 in [5, 6]
x in 1..3
---
number "5"
keyword "in"
punct "["
number "5"
punct ","
number "6"
punct "]"
name "x"
keyword "in"
number "1"
punct ".."
number "3"

=== in after a number at the end is inches
48 in
48 in + 1 ft
---
number "48"
unit "in"
number "48"
unit "in"
punct "+"
number "1"
unit "ft"

=== text with interpolation
"Detention, stop {stop.sequence}"
---
text "\"Detention, stop "
interpolation "{"
name "stop"
punct "."
name "sequence"
interpolation "}"
text "\""

=== text escapes
"a \"b\" \\ \n \t \u{1F600} {{ }}"
---
text "\"a "
escape "\\\""
text "b"
escape "\\\""
text " "
escape "\\\\"
text " "
escape "\\n"
text " "
escape "\\t"
text " "
escape "\\u{1F600}"
text " "
escape "{{"
text " "
escape "}}"
text "\""

=== invalid escapes
"\q \u{110000} \u{}"
---
text "\""
error "\\q"
text " "
error "\\u{110000}"
text " "
error "\\u{}"
text "\""
! syntax 1..3 `\q` is not an escape; text knows `\"`, `\\`, `\n`, `\t` and `\u`
! syntax 4..14 Write a character code as `\u` and up to six hexadecimal digits in braces
! syntax 15..19 Write a character code as `\u` and up to six hexadecimal digits in braces

=== nested interpolation
"outer {"inner {x}"} end"
---
text "\"outer "
interpolation "{"
text "\"inner "
interpolation "{"
name "x"
interpolation "}"
text "\""
interpolation "}"
text " end\""

=== record braces inside an interpolation
"{ { a: 1 }.a }"
---
text "\""
interpolation "{"
punct "{"
name "a"
punct ":"
number "1"
punct "}"
punct "."
name "a"
interpolation "}"
text "\""

=== unterminated text ends at the line
"abc
let x = 1
---
text "\"abc"
keyword "let"
name "x"
punct "="
number "1"
! syntax 0..4 This text is missing its closing quote

=== unterminated interpolation ends at the line
"abc {x + 1
let y = 2
---
text "\"abc "
interpolation "{"
name "x"
punct "+"
number "1"
keyword "let"
name "y"
punct "="
number "2"
! syntax 11..11 This interpolation is missing its closing brace

=== comments and doc comments
// a comment
/// a doc
let x = 1 /// not a doc after code
//// four slashes is a comment
---
comment "// a comment"
doc "/// a doc"
keyword "let"
name "x"
punct "="
number "1"
comment "/// not a doc after code"
comment "//// four slashes is a comment"

=== every operator
?? ?. => -> .. ..= == != <= >= += -= + - * / % < > = . , : ( ) [ ] { } | ? _
---
punct "??"
punct "?."
punct "=>"
punct "->"
punct ".."
punct "..="
punct "=="
punct "!="
punct "<="
punct ">"
punct "="
punct "+="
punct "-="
punct "+"
punct "-"
punct "*"
punct "/"
punct "%"
punct "<"
punct ">"
punct "="
punct "."
punct ","
punct ":"
punct "("
punct ")"
punct "["
punct "]"
punct "{"
punct "}"
punct "|"
punct "?"
punct "_"

=== operators from other languages
a && b ! c ; 'x'
---
name "a"
error "&&"
name "b"
error "!"
name "c"
error ";"
error "'x'"
! syntax 2..4 Write `and` instead of `&&`
! syntax 7..8 Write `not` instead of `!`
! syntax 11..12 A statement ends at the end of its line, so `;` is not needed
! syntax 13..16 Text is written in double quotes

=== unknown characters
x # y ~ z
---
name "x"
error "#"
name "y"
error "~"
name "z"
! syntax 2..3 `#` can't be used in a tariff
! syntax 6..7 `~` can't be used in a tariff

=== names starting with an underscore
_x _ _1
---
error "_x"
punct "_"
error "_1"
! syntax 0..2 A name starts with a letter, not `_`
! syntax 5..7 A name starts with a letter, not `_`

=== a number too large to hold
123456789012345678901234567890123
---
error "123456789012345678901234567890123"
! syntax 0..33 This number has more digits than a number can hold (28)

=== non-ascii text keeps its characters
"café 🚚 °F"
---
text "\"café 🚚 °F\""

=== a name with a non-ascii letter
tarifa_año
---
error "tarifa_año"
! syntax 0..11 `tarifa_año` can't be a name: names use the letters a to z, digits and `_`

=== text nested deeper than the limit
"{"{"{"{"{"{"{"{"x"}"}"}"}"}"}"}"}"
---
text "\""
interpolation "{"
text "\""
interpolation "{"
text "\""
interpolation "{"
text "\""
interpolation "{"
text "\""
interpolation "{"
text "\""
interpolation "{"
text "\""
interpolation "{"
text "\""
interpolation "{"
error "\"x\"}\"}\"}\"}\"}\"}\"}\"}\""
! limit 16..35 Text is interpolated more than 8 levels deep
